problems_fixed.what: Duplicate answer within silver tier: S0 (CaCO3, 5.0 g) and S1 (Na, 2.3 g) both gave 1.2 dm3. Bumped sodium mass 2.3 g -> 4.6 g so S1 now gives a clean 2.4 dm3. Recomputed guided_steps and misconception expect (4.8).

opener_concept: Sweets-factory waste tray: 75 g of every 100 g sets as the sweet you sell, 25 g is waste stuck to the tray. Student reads the 75% straight off (that IS atom economy: desired product / all products x 100). Second box scales identical gas balloons (3 mol -> 72 dm3) to reveal molar volume V = moles x 24.
rounding_note: Atom-economy answers that do not terminate (G1 Route B, G5 KClO3) have their final compute box stated to 2 d.p. (75.68, 39.18) because the guided engine checks boxes at +/-0.005 and the 1 d.p. value would fall outside that window; a done-note then states the 1 d.p. answer (75.7%, 39.2%) that matches the stored solution + accept 0.1. S4 (45.9) rounds cleanly within tolerance at 1 d.p. so was left as 1 d.p.
